title: Spyglass: Now Available!
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing this powerful new tool to all our users.

title: Enhanced File Control in the Editor
summary: Our updated editor now empowers you to effortlessly manage all your uploaded files and customize their visual presentation for a polished and controlled content experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to introduce our new public roadmap, providing a transparent view of completed features, upcoming developments, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a seamless and intuitive experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and visually integrated for enhanced productivity.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, designed to make co-editing more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Seamless Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on all relevant shared content, empowering you to work more effectively with your team and bring your ideas to life.

title: Worldwide Language Accessibility
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for a diverse range of international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Embrace unparalleled transparency and community collaboration as we open-source Noeko, giving you more control and a direct role in its evolution.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Graph
summary: This upgrade transforms your Constellation view into a dynamic knowledge hub, allowing precise filtering by tags, timeframes, and shared content to accelerate discovery and workflow.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge with Advanced Search and Custom Collections
summary: Efficiently discover, filter, and save tailored views of your information with powerful new search capabilities, transforming how you access and organize your most valuable insights.

title: Visualizing Connected Ideas
summary: Unleash the full potential of your notes with versatile display options that intuitively structure your ideas and enhance how you interact with connected content.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: We're thrilled to launch Noeko's self-hosting option and introduce new premium plans, giving you unparalleled control and tailored features for your workflow.

title: Vibrant New Themes for Your Workspace
summary: Transform your workspace with a suite of beautifully designed themes, offering improved aesthetics and more personalization choices.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're enhancing your personalized experience with updated greetings that perfectly match the time of day, ensuring a warm welcome from morning to night.

title: Effortlessly Organize Your Tags
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by performing quick actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, or viewing details directly within any tag view.

title: Unlock More Information Sources
summary: Seamlessly bring in and interact with your favorite YouTube videos, essential websites, and text documents, transforming how you gather and utilize information.
